Then save the dashboard (Save dashboard button or Ctrl+S), giving it the dashboard title exactly: fwgr87-n1 Bench Dashboard. Confirm the save succeeded. Then report the dashboard's URL as shown in the browser address bar, and the panel title and data source name as shown on the page.
